report.incidentSummary: Starting at 13:40 IST (08:10 UTC) on 2026-09-17, autopay mandate registrations degraded for users attempting to set up SIPs via Gomti Bank. While overall platform mandate success remained near 90%, Gomti Bank mandate success rate dropped from ~97% to ~52%, driven by upstream API rejections returning error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'). Other partner banks and NPCI gateways remained completely healthy.
report.rootCauseStatement: Gomti Bank's upstream mandate endpoint began declining approximately 45-50% of mandate registration requests starting at 2026-09-17T08:10:00Z with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'), caused by an internal risk or fraud scoring threshold misconfiguration at Gomti Bank.

hypotheses.cause: Gomti Bank's upstream mandate endpoint began declining roughly 50% of mandate registration requests with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') due to an upstream risk rule or fraud scoring threshold misconfiguration.
hypotheses.rationale: Metrics demonstrate that failure onset is strictly isolated to Gomti Bank at 08:10 UTC, where mandate success dropped from ~97% to ~52% and bank error rate rose from ~0.65% to >43%, while other partner banks remained healthy at ~96-97% success. Upstream logs at both mandate-service and bank-connector confirm explicit HTTP error responses with code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').

hypotheses.cause: Configuration change CHG-48222 on mandate-service increased npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms at 08:00 UTC, causing requests to be terminated prematurely by api-gateway's 5000ms client timeout.
hypotheses.rationale: CHG-48222 occurred at 08:00 UTC, 10 minutes prior to error onset at 08:10 UTC. Bank-connector timeout counts remained at baseline (~0/min), api-gateway error rates on /v1/mandates showed no increase (0.22-0.33%), and failures were isolated to Gomti Bank rather than all NPCI mandate requests.

facts.statement: At 2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z, configuration change CHG-48222 increased npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms on mandate-service.
mandate-service error rate rose sharply from ~1.0% to 3.57% at 08:10 UTC, reaching ~6.0% by 08:15 UTC and persisting through 10:25 UTC.

mandate_success_rate for Gomti Bank fell from ~97% at 08:05 UTC to 75.69% at 08:10 UTC and ~52.58% at 08:15 UTC, while all other partner banks (indus_valley, kaveri, northstar, sahyadri) maintained ~96.2%-97.4% success rates.

bank-connector bank_error_rate for Gomti Bank jumped from ~0.64% at 08:05 UTC to 21.78% at 08:10 UTC and ~43.0% at 08:15 UTC, remaining between 40% and 48% through 10:25 UTC, while other banks stayed at ~0.6%-0.8%.
bank-connector timeout_count across all banks remained near zero (0 to 0.4/min) throughout 07:30 to 10:25 UTC.
mandate-service traffic to Gomti Bank remained steady at 18-22 requests/minute across the investigation window.
bank-connector logged 115 error occurrences between 08:10:13 UTC and 08:34:56 UTC of 'POST /mandates -> # {"code":"U#","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}'.

mandate-service logged over 600 errors beginning at 2026-09-17T08:10:02.145Z (13:40:02.145 IST) with error_code 'U16' for bank 'gomti', stating 'mandate <ref> failed: bank declined (U16 risk threshold exceeded)'.
api-gateway error rates on /v1/mandates and /v1/sip remained flat at baseline (~0.22%-0.37%) throughout 07:30 to 10:30 UTC.

inferences.statement: The overall platform mandate failure rate increase of ~5% is entirely accounted for by Gomti Bank declining approximately half of its mandate registrations.
The failure is an upstream partner API rejection with U16 status code rather than an NPCI network outage, latency degradation, or gateway timeout issue.

assumptions.statement: The U16 risk threshold rejections originate from Gomti Bank's internal fraud and risk rule configuration rather than invalid or malformed parameters sent only for Gomti Bank accounts by mandate-service.
Gomti Bank's mandate API is invoked as an external partner dependency via bank-connector.

timeline.event: CHG-48222 increases npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms on mandate-service.
Gomti Bank bank_error_rate on bank-connector surges to 21.78%, and mandate success rate drops to 75.69%.
First logged mandate failure in mandate-service with error_code U16 ('bank declined (U16 risk threshold exceeded)') for Gomti Bank.
First logged bank-connector upstream rejection with 'risk threshold exceeded' on POST /mandates.
Gomti Bank mandate success rate stabilizes at ~52%, and bank error rate reaches ~43%, while all other partner banks remain at baseline (~97% success).
Incident INC-4557 reported by Payments product manager.

confidence.rationale: High confidence supported by complete time-series metrics showing isolated degradation exclusively on Gomti Bank starting at 08:10 UTC, coupled with structured error logs from both mandate-service and bank-connector confirming explicit U16 'risk threshold exceeded' error codes.

gaps.description: Lack of direct communication or incident bulletin from Gomti Bank partner operations confirming their internal risk engine change.
gaps.impact: Cannot confirm internal technical details within Gomti Bank's infrastructure, but does not impact the conclusion that the upstream bank endpoint is rejecting requests.

gaps.description: bank_latency_p95_ms query (ev_4) returned partial records due to storage read errors, and api-gateway latency metrics could not be fetched within tool call budget.
gaps.impact: No impact on root cause identification; timeout counts and error logs conclusively eliminate latency and timeout drops.

recommendedActions.action: Escalate INC-4557 to Gomti Bank partner banking and operations desk regarding U16 'risk threshold exceeded' rejections on mandate registration.
recommendedActions.rationale: The rejections are generated upstream by Gomti Bank's risk scoring service and require bank-side threshold adjustment or rule rollback.
recommendedActions.verification: Check bank-connector bank_error_rate for Gomti returns below 1% and mandate-service mandate_success_rate for Gomti recovers to >96%.

recommendedActions.action: Display an in-app advisory or prompt Gomti Bank users attempting SIP autopay setup to choose an alternate bank or netbanking mandate method.
recommendedActions.rationale: Mitigates drop-off for affected users while Gomti Bank resolves their internal risk evaluation issue.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor user setup conversion and drop-off rates on Gomti Bank autopay journeys.

recommendedActions.action: Realign mandate-service's npci.timeout_ms and client timeouts to be strictly lower than api-gateway's client timeout (5000ms).
recommendedActions.rationale: Although not the cause of this incident, having a 10000ms downstream timeout behind a 5000ms gateway timeout creates a structural timeout vulnerability under slow upstream conditions.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify mandate-service configuration via get_changes or service config endpoint showing timeout <= 4500ms.

findings.summary: At 08:00:00 UTC (10 minutes prior to symptom onset), CHG-48222 increased mandate-service's npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms. No other changes or deployments were made to mandate-service, bank-connector, or database in the investigation window. This timeout increase conflicts with api-gateway's 5000ms client timeout to mandate-service, meaning slow NPCI or bank calls exceeding 5000ms will be cut off by api-gateway. Similar past incidents (PIR-2008, PIR-1624) stemmed from NPCI e-mandate gateway degradation.

observations.statement: At 2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z (10 minutes before the reported onset of 08:10:00.000Z), configuration change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service by author v.rao, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms.

No deployments or flag changes were applied to mandate-service, bank-connector, or database between 2026-09-17T02:00:00.000Z and 2026-09-17T10:30:00.000Z. The only other changes across all services were telemetry scrape interval on assistant-orchestrator (CHG-48548 at 08:26 UTC) and a pagination fix deploy on market-data-service (CHG-48557 at 09:18 UTC).

In the dependency graph, api-gateway calls mandate-service synchronously with a 5000ms timeout and 0 retries, while mandate-service calls npci with retries=1 and had a timeout of 8000ms, now increased to 10000ms. Mandate-service also connects synchronously to bank-connector (timeout 8000ms, retries 0) and database (timeout 1000ms, retries 0).

Increasing npci.timeout_ms to 10000ms in mandate-service creates or exacerbates an upstream timeout mismatch with api-gateway (which times out after 5000ms). If NPCI mandate registration requests take between 5000ms and 10000ms (or on retry), api-gateway will terminate the connection with a 504/timeout error before mandate-service completes, leading to mandate setup failures for users.

Past incidents PIR-2008 (2026-09-03) and PIR-1624 (2026-08-24) both involved mandate setup failure spikes caused by external NPCI e-mandate gateway degradation across banks. Another incident, PIR-1328 (2026-08-27), was caused by partner bank batch processing slowdown affecting debits.
On 2026-09-16 at 09:57:19.248Z, bank-connector had an autoscaling change (CHG-48523, max_replicas raised 12 -> 17), with no subsequent changes leading into the incident window.

# Investigation report: Autopay setup failing for some users

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.92 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Starting at 13:40 IST (08:10 UTC) on 2026-09-17, autopay mandate registrations degraded for users attempting to set up SIPs via Gomti Bank. While overall platform mandate success remained near 90%, Gomti Bank mandate success rate dropped from ~97% to ~52%, driven by upstream API rejections returning error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'). Other partner banks and NPCI gateways remained completely healthy.

**Root cause:** Gomti Bank's upstream mandate endpoint began declining approximately 45-50% of mandate registration requests starting at 2026-09-17T08:10:00Z with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'), caused by an internal risk or fraud scoring threshold misconfiguration at Gomti Bank.

## Hypotheses
1. **Gomti Bank's upstream mandate endpoint began declining roughly 50% of mandate registration requests with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') due to an upstream risk rule or fraud scoring threshold misconfiguration.** — `bank-apis`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.92, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_5, ev_7, ev_10, ev_14, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18] · Contradicting: none
   - Metrics demonstrate that failure onset is strictly isolated to Gomti Bank at 08:10 UTC, where mandate success dropped from ~97% to ~52% and bank error rate rose from ~0.65% to >43%, while other partner banks remained healthy at ~96-97% success. Upstream logs at both mandate-service and bank-connector confirm explicit HTTP error responses with code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').
2. **Configuration change CHG-48222 on mandate-service increased npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms at 08:00 UTC, causing requests to be terminated prematurely by api-gateway's 5000ms client timeout.** — `mandate-service`, config_change, confidence 0.08, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_8, ev_9] · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_13, ev_14, ev_16, ev_17]
   - CHG-48222 occurred at 08:00 UTC, 10 minutes prior to error onset at 08:10 UTC. Bank-connector timeout counts remained at baseline (~0/min), api-gateway error rates on /v1/mandates showed no increase (0.22-0.33%), and failures were isolated to Gomti Bank rather than all NPCI mandate requests.

## Facts
- At 2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z, configuration change CHG-48222 increased npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms on mandate-service. [ev_1, ev_8]
- mandate-service error rate rose sharply from ~1.0% to 3.57% at 08:10 UTC, reaching ~6.0% by 08:15 UTC and persisting through 10:25 UTC. [ev_3]
- mandate_success_rate for Gomti Bank fell from ~97% at 08:05 UTC to 75.69% at 08:10 UTC and ~52.58% at 08:15 UTC, while all other partner banks (indus_valley, kaveri, northstar, sahyadri) maintained ~96.2%-97.4% success rates. [ev_7]
- bank-connector bank_error_rate for Gomti Bank jumped from ~0.64% at 08:05 UTC to 21.78% at 08:10 UTC and ~43.0% at 08:15 UTC, remaining between 40% and 48% through 10:25 UTC, while other banks stayed at ~0.6%-0.8%. [ev_5]
- bank-connector timeout_count across all banks remained near zero (0 to 0.4/min) throughout 07:30 to 10:25 UTC. [ev_6]
- mandate-service traffic to Gomti Bank remained steady at 18-22 requests/minute across the investigation window. [ev_10]
- bank-connector logged 115 error occurrences between 08:10:13 UTC and 08:34:56 UTC of 'POST /mandates -> # {"code":"U#","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}'. [ev_16]
- mandate-service logged over 600 errors beginning at 2026-09-17T08:10:02.145Z (13:40:02.145 IST) with error_code 'U16' for bank 'gomti', stating 'mandate <ref> failed: bank declined (U16 risk threshold exceeded)'. [ev_14, ev_17, ev_18]
- api-gateway error rates on /v1/mandates and /v1/sip remained flat at baseline (~0.22%-0.37%) throughout 07:30 to 10:30 UTC. [ev_13]

## Inferences
- The overall platform mandate failure rate increase of ~5% is entirely accounted for by Gomti Bank declining approximately half of its mandate registrations. [ev_3, ev_7, ev_10]
- The failure is an upstream partner API rejection with U16 status code rather than an NPCI network outage, latency degradation, or gateway timeout issue. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_13, ev_16, ev_17]

## Assumptions
- The U16 risk threshold rejections originate from Gomti Bank's internal fraud and risk rule configuration rather than invalid or malformed parameters sent only for Gomti Bank accounts by mandate-service.
- Gomti Bank's mandate API is invoked as an external partner dependency via bank-connector.

## Timeline
- **2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z (13:30:00 IST)** CHG-48222 increases npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms on mandate-service. [ev_1, ev_8]
- **2026-09-17T08:10:00.000Z (13:40:00 IST)** Gomti Bank bank_error_rate on bank-connector surges to 21.78%, and mandate success rate drops to 75.69%. [ev_5, ev_7]
- **2026-09-17T08:10:02.145Z (13:40:02 IST)** First logged mandate failure in mandate-service with error_code U16 ('bank declined (U16 risk threshold exceeded)') for Gomti Bank. [ev_14, ev_17, ev_18]
- **2026-09-17T08:10:13.150Z (13:40:13 IST)** First logged bank-connector upstream rejection with 'risk threshold exceeded' on POST /mandates. [ev_16]
- **2026-09-17T08:15:00.000Z (13:45:00 IST)** Gomti Bank mandate success rate stabilizes at ~52%, and bank error rate reaches ~43%, while all other partner banks remain at baseline (~97% success). [ev_5, ev_7]
- **2026-09-17T09:15:00.000Z (14:45:00 IST)** Incident INC-4557 reported by Payments product manager.

## Confidence
0.92: High confidence supported by complete time-series metrics showing isolated degradation exclusively on Gomti Bank starting at 08:10 UTC, coupled with structured error logs from both mandate-service and bank-connector confirming explicit U16 'risk threshold exceeded' error codes.

## Gaps
- Lack of direct communication or incident bulletin from Gomti Bank partner operations confirming their internal risk engine change. (impact: Cannot confirm internal technical details within Gomti Bank's infrastructure, but does not impact the conclusion that the upstream bank endpoint is rejecting requests.)
- bank_latency_p95_ms query (ev_4) returned partial records due to storage read errors, and api-gateway latency metrics could not be fetched within tool call budget. (impact: No impact on root cause identification; timeout counts and error logs conclusively eliminate latency and timeout drops.)

- **[now]** Escalate INC-4557 to Gomti Bank partner banking and operations desk regarding U16 'risk threshold exceeded' rejections on mandate registration. [ev_5, ev_7, ev_16, ev_17]
  - Why: The rejections are generated upstream by Gomti Bank's risk scoring service and require bank-side threshold adjustment or rule rollback.
  - Verify: Check bank-connector bank_error_rate for Gomti returns below 1% and mandate-service mandate_success_rate for Gomti recovers to >96%.
- **[now]** Display an in-app advisory or prompt Gomti Bank users attempting SIP autopay setup to choose an alternate bank or netbanking mandate method. [ev_7]
  - Why: Mitigates drop-off for affected users while Gomti Bank resolves their internal risk evaluation issue.
  - Verify: Monitor user setup conversion and drop-off rates on Gomti Bank autopay journeys.
- **[next]** Realign mandate-service's npci.timeout_ms and client timeouts to be strictly lower than api-gateway's client timeout (5000ms). [ev_1, ev_9]
  - Why: Although not the cause of this incident, having a 10000ms downstream timeout behind a 5000ms gateway timeout creates a structural timeout vulnerability under slow upstream conditions.
  - Verify: Verify mandate-service configuration via get_changes or service config endpoint showing timeout <= 4500ms.
